from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInterestIncome(BaseModel):
    """One company's interest income reported in a financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the financial report")
    interest_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="The interest income amount as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported amount, e.g. '元', '百万元', '千元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the figure")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the interest income line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_interest_incomes: list[CompanyInterestIncome]
